identity_reconciliation.note: The shared PMB label is a reconciliation lead only. Source-level name decisions belong to one reported process; the 2024 funding case remains a separate observation.

coverage.interpretation: 31 organization observations are not 31 distinct parties: 29 election-funding labels, one later registration decision and one separate PMB naming record. The reviewed HTML funding table is historical election data, not a time-frozen registry as of the research cutoff. The June 2024 aggregate announcement does not date the later release rows.
unresolved: No full Brazilian organization census or leadership timeline from 1990 through 7 September 2026 has been established.
Reconcile FEFC labels and exact process references with dated legal identities, complete names, extinct organizations, splits, mergers and name changes.
The current live registry was not used to backdate leaders or party names. A pre-cutoff archived registry snapshot remains to be obtained.
PCB and PMB release cells are dashes: no date, refusal, nonpayment, inactivity or exclusion is inferred.
The PMB article and initial notice use different names; retain the later explicit rectification and research underlying decisions before creating lifecycle intervals.
Federations, informal parties, parties in formation and institutions are outside this bounded intake; absence here does not establish nonexistence.
All game mappings, leadership roles, continuous lifecycle intervals, successor eligibility and portrait permissions remain unknown.
